title: Psychology of face recognition and likeness

queue.claim: 3D shape and 2D surface reflectance (pigmentation) contribute roughly equally to face recognition (O'Toole, Vetter & Blanz 1999; Russell & Sinha 2007).
queue.query: O'Toole Vetter Blanz 1999 three-dimensional shape two-dimensional surface reflectance contributions face recognition

queue.claim: Familiar faces remain recognisable after large uniform horizontal or vertical stretching (reportedly up to about 2×), but not when only one half is stretched (Hole et al. 2002; Sandford & Burton 2014).
queue.query: Hole George Eaves Rasek 2002 effects of geometric distortions on face recognition performance stretched faces
